evals.prompt: I want to make a skill that turns rough commit messages into proper conventional commit format. It should pull from staged changes and rewrite the message in place.
evals.expected_output: A new skill bundle under skills/conventional-commits/ with SKILL.md, optionally a scripts/rewrite.py helper. Description follows capability + triggers shape.

evals.prompt: Update my existing pdf-extract skill — it's too verbose and the description doesn't trigger when users say 'pull text out of this doc'. Tighten it.
evals.expected_output: Edited SKILL.md with shorter body and an updated description that covers the 'pull text out of' phrasing. May propose a description-optimization run.

evals.prompt: Run evals on my new spreadsheet-formatter skill. I have 3 test prompts in mind. Let's see how it does with vs without.
evals.expected_output: Spawns subagent pairs (with-skill / baseline) for each prompt, captures timing, drafts assertions, runs the grader, generates the review viewer.
